special_traits.name: Hold Breath
special_traits.description:
The crocodile can hold its breath
for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The crocodile makes one Bite attack and
one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10
+ 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and can't be targeted by the crocodile's Tail.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8
+ 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
